targets.baseline_commit_message: audio-transcription: five launch-video transcript readers, moved byte for byte

preserve: srt and vtt cues are read by their timestamps (comma or dot fractions, any number of digits) with HTML entities undone and whitespace folded
a txt file is read as '## h:mm:ss.fff - h:mm:ss.fff' blocks, else as 'hh:mm:ss:ff - hh:mm:ss:ff' timecode blocks at the given frames per second, with its 'source:' line kept
a json file keeps its source, duration, segments and each segment's words
timing is word when any word was read, segment when only segments were, none otherwise; a file with no timed text keeps its whole text folded
duration is the file's own, else the end of its last segment
a file already read, or not in the bytes folder, is skipped and counted
allowed_deltas: the list, the bytes folder, the output folder, the root and origin names and the frames per second are arguments, not one drive's folders
read-file reads one file to one words.json
the last line is {"result": {written, already_read, not_in_files, by_format_and_timing}}
banned_substitutions: a drive name or folder written in code
_paths: The source lives in a private repository, so it is named by the BLAKE3 identity of its path (path_multihash); a checkout of that repository beside this one finds it.
